articles.summary: SAN JOSE, Calif., April 22, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- QuantumScape Corporation (NASDAQ: QS), a global leader in next-generation solid-state lithium-metal battery technology, today announced its business and financial results for the first quarter of 2026, which ended March 31.
articles.title: QuantumScape Reports First Quarter 2026 Business and Financial Results

Dr. Maybury brings decades of leadership experience
articles.title: Former U.S. Air Force Chief Scientist Dr. Mark Maybury Joins QuantumScape Strategic Advisory Board
